rules.description: A non-null field value with status FACT or INFERRED must carry a source. A value with no source is fabricated - downgrade it to MISSING or CONFLICT instead of shipping it unbacked.

Output text matching a placeholder pattern (TODO, TBD, PLACEHOLDER, FIXME, XXX, lorem ipsum, example.com/.org/.net) signals unfinished or invented content that must never reach a committed file or the dashboard.
A safety, cleanliness, or climate letter grade with no sibling sources (a URL or list of URLs) is an invented grade. Every grade must cite at least one source.
A price or rent field represented as a string (with a currency symbol, commas, or any non-numeric character) instead of a plain number violates the numeric-price contract in references/contracts.md.
A unit marked live: true with no verified_at timestamp and no evidence (screenshot or unit_deep_link) is an unverified claim of liveness - liveness must be provably checked, never assumed.
